title: Shoplifting Couple Decides to Run After Being Caught
description:
Her boyfriend abandoned her right after they were caught shoplifting together. Situations like this are ideal for criminal couples to test their compatibility. These two certainly needed to have a conversation. Neither of them seemed to have any regrets about the shoplifting. It must have been just another rodeo for them. The female had a previous warrant and both of them were charged with theft, complicit and obstruction of official business.
